heading: Wisconsin Food Banks Receive First Eggs from Settlement
summary: Wisconsin DOJ said more than 400,000 eggs reached food banks and community organizations in the first round of deliveries. The shipments are part of approximately two million eggs secured for Wisconsin through a multistate settlement over alleged price coordination. The first deliveries went to Feeding America Eastern Wisconsin locations in Appleton and Milwaukee.

heading: Wisconsin Joins Hims & Hers Lawsuit Over Privacy and Billing
summary: Wisconsin Attorney General Josh Kaul announced that the state joined the Federal Trade Commission and six other states in a lawsuit against telehealth provider Hims & Hers. The amended complaint alleges the company shared sensitive health information with advertising platforms including Meta and Snap despite telling consumers their information would remain private. The complaint also alleges the company failed to clearly disclose how soon it would charge for prescriptions after consumers submitted intake forms and made subscriptions difficult to cancel. Wisconsin is seeking a permanent court order, restitution for affected consumers, civil forfeitures and costs.
